definition: A reinforcement-learning-trained open reasoning model appearing as a comparison point in two archived studies. In the coding-agent work it is listed among the large open and closed reference models, with results reported on only three of eight benchmarks. In the verifiable-reward work it is among the models for which scoring the chain of thought as well as the answer reverses the pass@K verdict in reinforcement learning's favour at every budget -- the counterweight to the finding that base models win plain pass@K by producing wrong chains that land on right answers. Neither source describes the model.

evidence.note: Assigns credit in coding-agent RL by splitting each code diff into sub-diffs, matching semantically similar sub-diffs across rollouts to form advantage groups, and projecting the resulting diff-level advantage back onto the tokens that produced it.
evidence.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training

evidence.note: Shows that base models win pass@K on mathematics by producing wrong chains that land on right answers, and that scoring the chain too — CoT-Pass@K — reverses the verdict in RLVR's favour at every K.
evidence.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards Implicitly Incentivizes Correct Reasoning in Base LLMs

name: Skywork-OR1
